BEFORE WE MEET

Your first
questions.

Let’s discuss your situation ↗
Where should we start if our needs are not yet clear?+

An initial conversation helps us understand your context, business priorities and current challenges. We then help define a suitable scope before making a proposal.

How does an engagement work?+

We first agree on the objectives, scope, stakeholders and deliverables. Our analysis draws on available information and evidence. A final presentation brings together findings and priority actions.

Do you use recognised frameworks?+

Depending on the context, our work may draw on ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, EBIOS Risk Manager, COBIT and CIS Controls. Using these frameworks does not constitute certification of the firm or the client.

How can we request a proposal?+

Describe your needs using the form or email contact@iconsultingcabinet.com. Once we have clarified your expectations, we set out the scope, delivery approach and commercial terms in a proposal.
